spec.title: Setup: run rdf4j #1989's landed compliance tests under failsafe at both revisions
spec.description: Setup for case L09 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief.md, no claims. Second L09 job: the first (20261125-162448-setup-run-rdf4j-1989-s-landed-empty-grou) passed but never ran MemoryComplexSPARQLQueryTest or SPARQL12QueryTest, because compliance/sparql skips surefire and runs its *Test classes under failsafe 2.19.1 in integration-test/verify, and that job stopped at package. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/worktrees (L09-rdf4j-fix = 1767ceebe5d309238263bdca732b730cc47b3e45, L09-rdf4j-parent = c2c7a5265e6c40bc5dc2574260c96c3e10f9a87c), builds -pl compliance/sparql -am up to verify (JDK 8, Maven 3.9.9; scripts/rdf4j_verify.sh), with -Dit.test selecting the compliance classes and -Dtest=GroupIteratorTest. The first step is online so the failsafe plugin resolves; the rest run offline. Each step fails if a named class did not run. On the fix: MemoryComplexSPARQLQueryTest (gains six Max/Min/Sample empty-group tests), SPARQL12QueryTest (agg-empty-group-1/2) and GroupIteratorTest, online then offline; on the parent its own MemoryComplexSPARQLQueryTest and GroupIteratorTest; then the PR's test-side files on the parent, production code unchanged (expected: some new tests fail). Logs and JUnit summaries to ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/logs (L09-*.verify-*); worktrees restored and cleaned. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief-setup.md.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: each named class runs; the fix's pass online and offline, the parent's own pass, the transplant prints production-unchanged and TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED
